knownIssueAssessment.reasoning: #7 is about re-wiring a strategy on a HEALTHY/LIVE pool (funds stranded in the OLD strategy; mitigated by drain-first or replace at totalStaked==0). DEDUP-002 is setting a strategy on a token ALREADY IN TERMINAL MIGRATION (migrationInfo.active==true), where the idle balance IS the realized payout pile R that batchMigrate/userMigrate distribute. The address(old)==0 branch sweeps R into the new strategy, and migration being terminal/non-resumable + active blocking all other exits means there is no in-contract route to recover it: the permissionless escape hatch is bricked. A competent non-malicious owner would be surprised that 'wiring a yield strategy' on a migrating token destroys the migration payout pile — this is a NON-OBVIOUS Law-3 footgun, in scope, not the documented #7 design decision.

findings.title: phUSDPerDay division-before-multiplication truncates sub-second emission into the stored per-second rate

relatedLedger.relation: Class of accepted known issue 'Integer-division dust rounds DOWN (protocol favor)'.

dustComponent.matchedTo: Known issue #2 (integer-division dust rounds DOWN, protocol favor) + ledger wont-fix 35e9be8d (same dust class)
dustComponent.reasoning: floor(amountPerDay/86400)*86400 <= amountPerDay loses up to 86399 wei/day, rounding DOWN in the protocol's favor — exactly the documented and already-wont-fixed dust behavior. Suppressed.

zeroEmissionEdge.reasoning: DISTINCT from the dust class: an owner setting amountPerDay < 86400 base units yields perSecond == amountPerDay/86400 == 0, so the pool silently emits NOTHING (not merely dust-rounded). This sub-86400 silent-zero is a NON-OBVIOUS owner-config footgun (Law 3): a competent non-malicious owner would be surprised that a small-but-positive daily budget emits zero rewards with no revert. Known issue #2 blesses 'rounds DOWN', not 'rounds to a complete zero-emission state'. Flag for human confirmation rather than blanket-suppress (Law 1). Low/QA priority; economically negligible for 18-decimal phUSD but a genuine silent-failure edge worth a require/scaling guard.

reTriageFlag.detail: Confirm the dust portion is subsumed by accepted known issue #2 / wont-fix class 35e9be8d (suppressed), and separately decide the sub-86400-budget zero-emission edge (kept-flagged owner footgun).
